description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR4. TypeInterner is bottom-up hash-consing (one arena.push, mod.rs ~200) and order.rs ~32 terminates because a descriptor names only earlier ids; intern orders clauses on the construction path (mod.rs ~396). Reserve an id, fill it, rekey the index; cmp_ty becomes a total order on regular trees with a pair memo instead of id descent; the hygiene assert (mod.rs ~224) stops running on un-interned descriptors. No μ constructed yet. Tests: types_order_is_total_on_cyclic_nodes, types_intern_two_phase_is_idempotent, and cmp_ty(a,b) == Equal iff a == b re-proved. Gate: byte-identical double compiles and canon equality at every commit; SemanticOrd everywhere bottoms out in this order.
title: Two-phase intern and a terminating clause order on regular trees
